title: Add comprehensive UI component system (81 components) with mobile-first design
body:
Adds production-ready UI component specifications for enterprise management software. Components are designed mobile-first with WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

## Components Added (81 total)

**Input (28)**: Text (single/multi-line, rich), Number (numeric, currency, slider, rating), Date/Time (picker, range), Select (dropdown, autocomplete, tags, cascader), Boolean (checkbox, switch, radio, toggle), File (upload, image w/ crop), Advanced (color, signature, location, code editor)

**Display (23)**: Text (label, badge, tag, pill), Rich Content (HTML, Markdown, code block), Media (image, avatar, icon, video), Progress (bar, circle, spinner, skeleton), Stats (KPI, trend, gauge), Info (timeline, divider)

**Layout (22)**: Containers (card, panel, section, well), Grids (12-col responsive, masonry, flex, stack, split-pane), Navigation (tabs, accordion, stepper, breadcrumb, pagination), Overlays (modal, drawer, popover, tooltip, toast, dropdown)

**Specialized (8)**: Data (table w/ virtual scroll, tree, kanban), Feedback (alert, empty state), Mobile (bottom nav, FAB, pull-to-refresh)

## Architecture

All components follow Zod-first pattern:
- Runtime validation via Zod schemas
- TypeScript types via `z.infer<>`
- JSON schemas auto-generated for IDE support
- Responsive breakpoints: xs (480), sm (640), md (768), lg (1024), xl (1280), 2xl (1536)

## Usage

```typescript
import { GridProps, KpiCardProps, TextInputProps } from '@objectstack/spec';

// Responsive grid adapts to screen size
const layout: GridProps = {
  columns: { xs: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 },  // Stack on mobile, grid on desktop
  gap: 'lg'
};

// KPI with trend indicator
const revenue: KpiCardProps = {
  title: 'Revenue',
  value: '$125K',
  trend: { value: 12.5, direction: 'up', label: 'vs last month' }
};

// Touch-optimized input (≥44px tap target)
const email: TextInputProps = {
  size: 'large',
  autocomplete: 'email',
  clearable: true
};
```

## Files

- `src/ui/input.zod.ts` - Input components (700 LOC)
- `src/ui/display.zod.ts` - Display components (600 LOC)
- `src/ui/layout.zod.ts` - Layout components (600 LOC)
- `src/ui/component.zod.ts` - Master registry + specialized components
- `src/ui/*.test.ts` - Test coverage (58 new tests, 3,290 total passing)
- `src/ui/README.md` - Component reference guide

## Design Principles

Mobile-first (touch targets ≥44px), accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA), performant (virtual scroll, lazy load), type-safe (Zod + TypeScript).
